description: Completed in https://github.com/ergoplatform/ergo/pull/2930: eliminated O(M * N) linear secret scanning and 27,000 redundant secp256k1 point multiplications in ErgoProvingInterpreter, added O(1) public-key lookup in WalletVars.ownsAddress and O(1) Set lookup in OffChainRegistry / ErgoWalletState.walletFilter, and added regression tests for large HD wallets.
